name: Sanook Kitchen - Eastpoint Mall #01-15
description:
Sanook Kitchen is a casual dining place that offers a pleasant experience with their menu featuring a variety of delicious Thai Cuisine. A wallet-friendly prices serving from appetisers, soups, curries to seafood and more. Located at Eastpoint Mall and just a few minutes away from Simei MRT Station, Sanook Kitchen is the best location where people can share delectable dishes in a relaxed setting. MUST TRIES: Come and try their savoury dishes to satisfy your cravings. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
